title: Suppressing Compiler Lints
goal: Use lint attributes to selectively allow expected warnings in test helpers.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Compiler Lints

hints: The function has an outer `#[deny(unused_variables)]` attribute.
Use `#[allow(unused_variables)]` on the local variable to suppress the denied lint.
explanation: `#[allow(unused_variables)]` locally overrides the outer `#[deny(unused_variables)]` attribute, permitting the unused variable without a build error. Leaving `#[deny(unused_variables)]` causes compilation to fail on `let unused = 42;`. Using `assert!` fails compilation because `assert!(calc(3), 6)` has an invalid argument format, while `assert_ne!` panics because 6 equals 6.
